item.title: Rust Compiler Pipeline Refactor: 35% Faster Build Times, But There's a Catch
item.description: Our team's CI dropped from 42 minutes to 27 minutes just by upgrading the Rust compiler. This journey taught us one thing: performance optimization rewards those who measure, punishes those who guess.

item.title: Rust CI Optimization: Cargo Build Times Crashed Our Pipeline at 3 AM
item.description: Rust CI optimization实战指南: Cargo build times skyrocketed from 4 minutes to 35 minutes, causing CI Pipeline collapse at 3 AM. How we solved Cargo build time issues with sccache, incremental compilation, and multi-stage Rust Docker builds while maintaining $180K cloud cost savings.
